search.noResultsHint: Try another keyword, such as language or privacy.
search.aiConfigDescription: Models, providers, API keys, and generation preferences.

account.title: Account
account.usernameHint: 3-30 characters, letters, numbers, and underscores only

changePassword.title: Change Password
changePassword.description: Update your password. All other sessions will be signed out.

signOut.title: Sign Out
signOut.description: Sign out of your account on this device.

loginDevices.title: Login devices
loginDevices.description: Devices currently signed in to your account. Sign out any you don't recognize or forgot to log out of.
loginDevices.loadError: Could not load your devices. Try again later.
loginDevices.revokeError: Could not sign out that device. Try again later.
loginDevices.propagationNote: A signed-out device can take up to 5 minutes to be logged out. Changing your password signs out every other device immediately.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.description: Permanently delete your account and associated data.
deleteAccount.dialogDescription: Your account remains active until you confirm the request from your email. After deletion, you may register again immediately, but the recreated account cannot be deleted until 3 days after this deletion.

warnings.identity: Your profile and every linked sign-in method will be removed.
warnings.deletionCooldown: The same email can register again immediately, including through Google or Discord, but the recreated account cannot be deleted again for 3 days after this deletion.
warnings.content: Your worlds, bundles, published content, playthroughs, messages, personas, and uploads will be deleted.
warnings.community: Other players may lose playthroughs, reviews, or replies attached to content you created.
warnings.billing: Any active subscription will end immediately. Remaining plan time and Mushies are not refunded.
warnings.records: Payment processors may retain billing and identity records as legally required for accounting or fraud prevention; they will no longer be linked to an active Yumina account.
warnings.antiAbuse: Pseudonymous security logs and limited analytics may be retained for required periods to prevent abuse and operate the service.
warnings.cache: Stored uploads are deleted, but existing browser or delivery-network caches may remain visible until their previous cache lifetime expires.

deleteAccount.pendingEarnings: Accounts with creator earnings still on hold cannot be deleted until those earnings are settled. Contact support if this applies to you.
deleteAccount.acknowledge: I understand that this permanently deletes my account and data. I may register again immediately, but the recreated account cannot be deleted again for 3 days after this deletion.
deleteAccount.emailSentDescription: We sent a deletion link to {{email}}. Your account remains active until you complete the final confirmation page. After deletion, you may register again immediately, but the recreated account cannot be deleted again for 3 days. The link expires in 1 hour.
deleteAccount.finalConfirmationDescription: This is the final step. Deletion begins as soon as you press the button below and cannot be reversed. You may register again immediately, but the recreated account cannot be deleted again for 3 days.
deleteAccount.signInRequiredDescription: For your security, sign in to this account in the same browser, then open the deletion link from your email again.

errors.confirmationMismatch: The confirmation text does not match your account.
errors.pendingEarnings: Creator earnings are still awaiting settlement. Contact support before deleting your account.
errors.billing: We could not safely cancel your billing. Try again later or contact support.
errors.creatorAccount: Your creator payout account could not be closed. Contact support before deleting your account.
errors.notReady: Account deletion is being prepared. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.cooldown: This email was used by an account deleted less than 3 days ago. You may keep using this account, but it cannot be deleted again yet.
errors.lastAdmin: The final administrator account cannot be deleted. Promote another trusted administrator first.
errors.referral: Accounts with referral history need support-assisted deletion so rewards cannot be claimed twice.
errors.protectedHistory: This account has an active safety restriction. Contact support for assisted deletion.
errors.email: We could not send the confirmation email. Try again later.
errors.invalidLink: This deletion link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one from Account settings.
errors.generic: Could not start account deletion. Try again later.

connectedAccounts.title: Sign-in methods
connectedAccounts.description: All linked methods sign you into this same account.

validation.usernameMinLength: Username must be at least 3 characters
validation.passwordMinLength: New password must be at least 8 characters

contentSafety.title: Content & Safety
contentSafety.description: Control what type of content you see on the platform.
contentSafety.minorRestriction: Limitless mode isn't available for this account.

audiencePreference.title: Audience Preference
audiencePreference.description: Choose which audience to see in the recommended feed. Does not affect search, tags, or creator pages.

all.label: For Everyone
all.description: See all stories, including male and female-oriented.

male.label: For Men
male.description: See male-oriented and general stories, hide female-oriented.

female.label: For Women
female.description: See female-oriented and general stories, hide male-oriented.

blurSensitive.title: Blur Limitless Media
blurSensitive.description: Blur thumbnails for Limitless content on Discover.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Control who can see your activity and reach out to you.

privateAccount.title: Private Account
privateAccount.description: Only people you follow can see your published worlds, stats, and activity.

allowDMs.title: Allow Private Messages
allowDMs.description: Let other users start a direct message conversation with you.

showRecentPlay.title: Show Recent Play
showRecentPlay.description: Display your recently played worlds on your public profile.

profileVisibility.title: Profile Visibility
profileVisibility.description: Choose who can see the private parts of your profile. When your profile is restricted, other people cannot see your published worlds on your profile, recent play, followers/following lists, or favorites.

public.title: Public
public.description: Anyone can view your profile details and profile sections.

followers.title: People I follow
followers.description: Only people you follow can view your published worlds and private profile data.

private.title: Private
private.description: Only you can view your published worlds and private profile data.

showPlayHistory.title: Show Play History
showPlayHistory.description: Display your recently played worlds on your public profile.

showStats.title: Show My Data
showStats.description: Display playtime and creator statistics on your public profile.

showFollowLists.title: Show Followers / Following Lists
showFollowLists.description: Let others open your followers and following lists. The counts still show either way.

showFavorites.title: Show My Favorites
showFavorites.description: Display favorites and library previews on your public profile.

blacklist.title: Blacklist
blacklist.subtitle: Manage blocked users
blacklist.hideMyWorlds: Hide my world cards from them
blacklist.hideTheirActivity: Hide their reviews and community posts

groups.engagementDesc: Favorites, reviews, likes, and tips on your worlds and bundles.
groups.socialDesc: New followers and publishes from creators you follow.
groups.libraryDesc: Updates and status changes for worlds in your library.
groups.communityDesc: Replies, likes, and rewards on your forum posts.

fontSize.title: Font Size
fontSize.hint: Changes apply instantly and are saved to this device.

autoFullscreenOnPlay.title: Auto-enter fullscreen when playing
autoFullscreenOnPlay.description: Automatically enter immersive fullscreen when opening a card with a custom interface. When off, cards open in the normal layout and you can enter fullscreen anytime with the fullscreen button. Saved to your account.

worldAudio.title: World music & sound effects
worldAudio.description: When off, worlds play no background music or sound effects at all — fully silent. Saved to your account.

sendKey.title: Press Enter to send
sendKey.description: When on, Enter sends your message and Shift+Enter starts a new line. When off, Ctrl/⌘+Enter sends and Enter starts a new line.

wallpaper.title: Wallpaper
wallpaper.description: Choose a different wallpaper for each page and tune how strong the background feels.

opacity.title: Wallpaper Opacity
opacity.description: Keeps each page's own visual balance, but lets you make the wallpaper fainter or stronger overall.
opacity.hint: Hub, profile, settings, and library backgrounds

gradient.title: Bottom Gradient Strength
gradient.description: Controls how strong the dark fade is near the bottom of immersive pages.

cloudyGlass.title: Cloudy Glass Strength
cloudyGlass.description: Makes the cloudy glass blurrier and denser without switching over to the clearer glass presets.

library.title: Wallpaper Library
library.description: Click a wallpaper to choose which page uses it.

upload.title: Upload Custom Wallpaper
upload.description: Uploaded images go into your "{{folderName}}" folder, and only images from that folder appear in this gallery.
